$comment: Single question list (implementation plan §1.3). Drives docs/discovery/client-questionnaire.md (npm run questionnaire:render), the discovery engine prompt mapping and the Phase 5 chatbot. maps_to = JSON pointers into schema/engagement.schema.json ('*' = every array item). feeds = gate:<id> | l_trigger:<id> | exit:<rule id> from schema/offering.json. Enum options are read from the schema, never duplicated here.

sections.title: Business outcomes
sections.intro: What is broken before what to build. This section is the primary brief: every capability we scope must trace back to an answer here.

sections.title: Company, brand & Shopify
sections.intro: Store setup, Shopify plan, brand positioning and assets.

sections.title: Catalogue & products
sections.intro: Product model, variants, metafields, pricing and inventory.

sections.title: Markets & internationalisation
sections.intro: Shopify Markets, currencies, languages, tax and duties.

sections.title: Payments & checkout
sections.intro: Payment providers, PCI scope and checkout customisation.

sections.title: Shipping & fulfilment
sections.intro: Fulfilment model, locations, rates, returns and notifications.

sections.title: Customers, B2B & privacy
sections.intro: Customer accounts, B2B, loyalty, segmentation and personal-data obligations.

sections.title: Marketing & promotions
sections.intro: SEO, analytics, email, reviews, affiliates, discounts and campaigns.

sections.intro: Every system that exchanges data with the store, and what moves from the current platform.

sections.intro: Timeline, decision-making, support, legal and project tooling.

questions.text: What is the single biggest thing preventing your ecommerce from growing right now?
How long has this been a problem, and what have you already tried to fix it?
If we solved only one thing in this engagement, what would have the highest business impact?
What is your current monthly ecommerce revenue (range and currency)?
What is your current conversion rate (%)?
Which product categories, markets or customer segments under-perform?
Is the main bottleneck acquisition (traffic), conversion (traffic doesn't buy) or retention (customers don't return)?
What manual work does your team do today that the platform should automate, and which processes break most often?
How many hours per week does the team spend on workarounds?
What does success look like in 12 months (revenue, new markets, channels, customer volume)?
Which KPIs will measure success? For each: metric, today's baseline, target, horizon in months.
What triggered this engagement — why Shopify, and why now?
If you are moving from another platform, what must not be lost in the transition?
What are you most unhappy with in the current store or set-up?
What is the approximate budget envelope for this project (range and currency)?
Is the priority to minimise upfront cost (apps and configuration), to own the solution (custom build), or a balance?
Is there a monthly ceiling for app subscriptions?
Trading name and legal entity name (if different).
Country of incorporation / headquarters.
Industry and product vertical.
Is the business direct-to-consumer, B2B, or hybrid?
Current website URL.
Is there an existing Shopify store?
Existing store URL, current Shopify plan and current theme.
Which Shopify plan will the new store run on? (All Foundation and Scale offers assume Shopify Plus.)
How is the brand positioned (value, mid-market, premium, luxury, enterprise)?
questions.help: Luxury or enterprise positioning routes the engagement to the Growth (L) offer.

questions.text: Is the brand identity finalised (logo, colour palette, typography)?
In which formats are brand assets available (SVG, PNG, Figma, guidelines PDF)?
Are there strict brand guidelines that must be followed?
What differentiates the brand — price, quality, exclusivity, community, sustainability?
Who are your top three online competitors?
Which stores (competitor or not) have a UX you want to reference?
How many active SKUs are in the catalogue (approximate)?
What is the maximum number of variant options on a product (e.g. size, colour, material = 3)?
questions.help: More than 3 options is a hard stop (11.5).

questions.text: What is the maximum number of variants on a single product?
Which product types exist in the catalogue?
Which subscription app is used or preferred?
Roughly how many collections?
Are collections manual, rule-based (automated), or mixed?
Which product attributes go beyond Shopify's standard fields (technical specs, certifications, fit guides, ingredients)?
Where is catalogue data maintained today?
Are there multiple price tiers (retail, trade, VIP)?
Is there volume or quantity-tiered pricing?
Do prices differ by market (not just currency conversion)?
Where is the inventory source of truth — Shopify, ERP, WMS, other?
Are low-stock alerts needed?
What should happen when a product is out of stock?
Which markets (countries) go live at launch? For each: country code, checkout currency, languages, domain.
questions.help: More than 5 markets (11.3) or more than 6 distinct languages (11.4) is a hard stop.

questions.text: Which is the primary market?
Which countries are planned in the next 12 months?
One store with Shopify Markets, separate expansion stores, or hybrid?
Should visitors be redirected to their local market automatically?
How will translation be handled?
Does any language need right-to-left layout?
Is SEO per language a priority?
Per market: is it the store's base currency, or are prices auto-converted, manually set, or display-only (checkout in another currency)?
questions.help: More than one transactional currency activates the multi-currency scope gate.

questions.text: Should duties and import taxes be collected at checkout (DDP)?
In which countries are you VAT-registered?
Do you sell into the US with state sales tax obligations?
Which payment providers will you use (Shopify Payments, Adyen, Stripe, PayPal…)?
Which local payment methods are required (TWINT, iDEAL, Bancontact, SEPA, invoice…)?
Which buy-now-pay-later providers, if any?
Do you need settlement in multiple currencies?
Will card data be handled only by Shopify-hosted checkout, by a third-party hosted payment page, or by custom card UI / tokenisation?
questions.help: Custom card handling is a hard stop (11.9).

questions.text: What level of checkout customisation is needed: none, Checkout Extensibility (branding, extra fields, upsells), or a fully custom checkout UI?
questions.help: Extensibility requires Shopify Plus (11.1); a custom checkout UI is a hard stop (11.6).

questions.text: Which checkout extensions are needed?
Which custom checkout fields are needed (company, VAT number, PO number, delivery instructions)?
Are post-purchase upsells needed?
Will gift cards be sold or accepted at checkout?
Is store credit needed?
Is manual fraud review needed for high-value orders?
Are there order restrictions by country, customer type or order value?
Do you fulfil in-house, through a 3PL, or both?
Which 3PL provider?
How many fulfilment locations are there?
Are there complex routing rules deciding which location fulfils an order?
Which carriers do you use?
Are shipping rates calculated live, flat, free above a threshold, or mixed?
Are there product-specific shipping rules (heavy, hazardous, temperature-controlled)?
Do you ship internationally?
Which countries do you not ship to?
Summarise the returns policy (window, conditions, who pays return postage).
Is a self-service returns portal needed?
Do you process exchanges (not only refunds)?
Which returns solution is used or preferred?
Do order, shipping and delivery notifications need custom design or content?
Are notifications sent by Shopify, by the email platform, or both?
Is guest checkout the default, are accounts optional, or is registration required?
New customer accounts (passwordless) or classic accounts?
What should the account area include (order history, addresses, returns, wishlist, subscriptions)?
Do you sell to business customers (B2B / wholesale)?
Do B2B customers need company accounts with their own login?
Do B2B customers get company-specific price lists?
Are there B2B volume discounts or quantity rules?
Which payment terms are needed (net 30, invoice, purchase order)?
Is there a request-for-quote workflow, or is pricing negotiated per buyer?
questions.help: An RFQ / negotiated-pricing workflow is a hard stop (11.2).

questions.text: Must B2B accounts be approved before they can order?
Native Shopify B2B or an app?
How many B2B accounts are expected within 12 months?
Which loyalty components are planned?
Is loyalty needed at launch or in a later phase?
Which loyalty app is used or preferred?
Must loyalty status sync to the email platform or CRM?
Which customer segments do you use today?
Where is segmentation driven from — Shopify, the email platform, a CDP, or a mix?
Which customer tags drive custom logic today (pricing, access, discounts)?
Which privacy regimes apply to your customers (GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA, Swiss nFADP)?
Which cookie consent tool is used or preferred?
Is explicit opt-in required for marketing emails?
Do you collect sensitive personal data (health, age, biometric, financial)?
Is a workflow needed for customer data export or deletion requests?
Is organic search a significant traffic channel?
Are custom URL structures needed?
Who manages SEO?
Which analytics platforms do you use (GA4, Adobe, other)?
Is server-side tracking needed?
Which advertising pixels are needed (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Google Ads)?
Is a tag manager already configured?
Which custom events must be tracked beyond standard ecommerce events?
Which email / CRM platform do you use or plan to use?
Which automated flows are needed (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back)?
Is Shopify or the email platform the master for customer segments?
Which product reviews app is used or preferred?
Is user-generated content important (customer photos, social embeds)?
Which affiliate platform, if any?
Do you use Shopify Collabs for influencers?
Are affiliate and influencer sales tracked via discount codes, UTM parameters, or both?
Which discount types are used?
Which discounts must stack (none, one code plus one automatic, or more)?
questions.help: Beyond one code plus one automatic discount needs a discount function (T3).

questions.text: Are coupon codes single-use, multi-use, or bulk-generated?
Must codes be brand-named (e.g. WELCOME20)?
Do codes need minimum order values or quantities?
Do codes expire on a fixed date, a rolling period, or never?
How are codes distributed (email, SMS, print, influencers)?
Are gift cards sold as a product?
Are gift cards issued as rewards or compensation?
Digital gift cards, physical, or both?
Must gift cards expire?
Are promotions triggered from email or SMS campaigns?
Does each campaign need its own landing page?
Are countdown timers or urgency elements needed?
Do promotions differ by market?

List every system that exchanges product, inventory, order, customer or financial data with the store. For each: system, category, direction, data objects, frequency, connector (native app / iPaaS / custom / none), owner, status.
questions.help: Any ERP, PIM, CRM, 3PL/WMS, OMS or custom connection activates the integration gate; more than 3 is a hard stop (11.7).

questions.text: Is there a middleware / iPaaS layer (Celigo, Boomi, MuleSoft, custom)?
Which platform are you migrating from (or none — greenfield)?
Which data must be migrated?
Approximate volumes: products, customers, orders, URL redirects.
Must historical orders be available inside Shopify?
How much SEO equity (rankings, backlinks) must be preserved?
Is there a Figma file or design mockup for the new store?
How complete is it — brand only, key screens, or every template?
Does the Figma file contain a full design system (tokens and components)?
Is the design mapped to Shopify sections and blocks?
Is a fully custom design required, rather than a theme with brand customisation?
Is a headless storefront required (Hydrogen, another framework, or a native app front end)?
questions.help: A headless requirement routes the engagement to the Growth (L) offer.

questions.text: Any theme preferences or existing theme licences?
What is the aesthetic direction (minimal, editorial, luxury, playful, utilitarian)?
Which interactive patterns are required (mega-menu, quick-add, swatches, predictive search, lookbook, video hero)?
Is custom motion or animation required?
Which accessibility standard applies?
Has an accessibility audit been done on the current site?
Core Web Vitals targets: LCP (seconds), CLS, INP (milliseconds).
Is page speed a known problem today?
Which third-party scripts must load (chat, personalisation, heatmaps)?
What is the target go-live date?
questions.help: Fewer weeks than the offer's minimum duration raises flag 11.15.

questions.text: What drives the deadline (peak season, product launch, contract end)?
Is a phased launch planned?
Preferred project kick-off date.
Who is involved on the client side? For each: role, RACI (R/A/C/I), decision-maker (yes/no). Names are optional.
Is there a single decision-maker for scope, approvals and feedback?
questions.help: No single decision-maker is a stop (11.16).

questions.text: Is budget approval authority clear?
Which roles need Shopify admin access after go-live?
Which training is needed (products, orders, discounts, reports)?
Are written SOPs required?
What post-launch support model is expected?
Is the Grow retainer signed?
questions.help: Not signed on M or L: warning 11.11 (commercial adjustment).

questions.text: Retainer length in months.
Is the business in a regulated industry (pharma, alcohol, firearms, age-restricted goods, financial products, medical devices)? If yes, which?
questions.help: A regulated industry is a hard stop until legal review (11.8).

questions.text: Are legal pages (terms, privacy, cookies, returns) ready, in need of updates, or still to be drafted?
Any other industry-specific compliance requirements?
Lead consultant.
Has the client agreed that answers may be processed by the AI discovery engine (no customer personal data included)?
questions.help: ADR 0007 — the engine refuses to run without recorded consent.

questions.text: Jira site and project key for the backlog.
Jira components to use.
